description: Use this when the user tells you, or asks you to remember, change or forget something about their own food tastes in ChefBear (for example "remember I'm allergic to peanuts", "I don't eat cilantro" or "I'm vegetarian now"), or confirms which dish they picked or turned down from one of their saved ChefBear menus. Adds or removes likes, dislikes, allergies and diets, sets or clears taste levels from 1 to 5, and records picks and rejections by menuId and the dish's id from get_menu. Record only what the user said about themselves, in this conversation or, when the server instructions say this connection keeps their profile up to date, in earlier ones you remember: never guess an allergy, diet or preference, and don't record a choice they didn't confirm. Repeating the same requestId with the same changes applies them once. Returns the updated profile. Needs the "Update your taste profile" permission.

allergies.description: Allergies or intolerances the user stated for themselves, such as peanuts or shellfish, to add.

diets.description: Diets the user follows, to add.

dislikes.description: Foods or ingredients the user doesn't want, to add.

likes.description: Foods, dishes, ingredients or cuisines the user likes, to add.

choices.description: Dishes the user confirmed they picked or turned down, from at most three of their saved menus.

menuId.description: The menuId from list_menus or get_import_status, or the menu's https://chef-bear.com/my-menu/ link.

verdict.description: picked: the user chose or ordered it. rejected: the user turned it down.

levels.description: Taste levels from 1 (not at all) to 5 (very much): spicy, oily, sweet, meat and adventure (trying unfamiliar dishes). null clears a level.

allergies.description: Allergies or intolerances the user stated for themselves, such as peanuts or shellfish, to remove.

diets.description: Diets the user follows, to remove.

dislikes.description: Foods or ingredients the user doesn't want, to remove.

likes.description: Foods, dishes, ingredients or cuisines the user likes, to remove.

requestId.description: A new unique ID for this change, such as a UUID. Repeating it with the same changes returns the same result instead of applying them twice.

name: update_taste_profile

changes.description: The changes as saved, when the connection may not read the profile.

profile.description: The saved profile, only when the connection may also read it.

hasProfile.description: False until the user saves something; the lists are then empty.

persona.description: The food personality from the ChefBear quiz, if the user took it.

recentChoices.description: Dishes the user picked or turned down, newest first.

updatedAt.description: When the profile last changed, ISO 8601 UTC.

replayed.description: True when this requestId was already applied; nothing changed this time.

updated.description: Always true: the change is saved (or was, for a replay).

title: Update your taste profile
